```yaml
name: Docs Preview Deploy
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs Preview PR"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: >
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == 'NVIDIA/NemoClaw'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download docs artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-build
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Get PR info
        id: pr_info
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}"
          # Extract PR number from branch name like "refs/pull/123/merge"
          PR_NUMBER=$(echo "$PR_NUMBER" | sed -E 's/.*pull\/([0-9]+)\/.*/\1/')
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: docs-build
          target-folder: pr-${{ steps.pr_info.outputs.pr_number }}
          clean: true
          clean-exclude: |
            pr-*
            index.html
            CNAME
```
